_readme: Arabic/English announcement text for commits whose message we cannot amend — upstream Equicord commits pulled in by a merge. Key is any unambiguous commit sha prefix. An override ALSO promotes an otherwise-skipped upstream commit (a 'PluginName: message' subject with no conventional prefix) into an «إصلاح · Fix» announcement showing the plugin name — so add one entry here for every upstream fix you want Esharq users to see. Commits we author ourselves should carry notify-ar:/notify-en: trailers instead; this file is only the fallback for foreign commits. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

51cc856.en: Added compact mode support to sric, so it renders correctly for anyone using the compact message layout instead of cozy.
